LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Word_Text: When {PAWN} came out at first light, there was a word written in the frost {WHERE}, in letters no hand had made: {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Where_Ground: on the open ground at the edge of the colony
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Fact_Bread: There are about {DAYS} days of food left in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Fact_Wood: There are {WOOD} logs left for the fires.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Fact_Count: There is {WHAT} spoiling on the colony's ground.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_Word: {WHO} found a word written in the frost at {HOME} at first light: {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Thaw_Text: {KEEPER} sat up all night by {FRAIL}'s bed, {WARMTH}. At first light the cold broke, and the frost on the ground ran off like water.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Warmth_3: keeping the heater by the bed running
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_Thaw: {WHO} sat up all night with {FRAIL} at {HOME} in a cold snap, and at first light the cold broke.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Walk_Text: In the night something walked {HOW} {HOME}, out past the walls, and where it went there is a line of frost an arm's width wide. Nobody saw what made it.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Walk_TextSeen: In the night something walked {HOW} {HOME}, out past the walls, and where it went there is a line of frost an arm's width wide. {WHO} saw it: tall and white, and it moved off whenever anyone came near.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_Walk: Something walked {HOW} {HOME} in the night and left a line of frost behind it.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_WalkSeen: {WHO} saw a tall white figure walk {HOW} {HOME} in the night, leaving a line of frost, and it moved off whenever anyone came near.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Grave_Text: At dusk frost lay thick on {DEAD}'s grave, and on nothing else. Then the cold came down over {HOME}, and nobody felt like talking.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Grave_TextQuiet: At dusk frost lay thick on {DEAD}'s grave, and on nothing else.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_Grave: {WHO} saw frost lying on {DEAD}'s grave at {HOME} at dusk, and on nothing else.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Melt_Text: The frost on {DEAD}'s grave has melted, and where it lay there is a ring of mushrooms.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Melt_TextBare: The frost on {DEAD}'s grave has melted away.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_Melt: The frost on {DEAD}'s grave at {HOME} melted away after a few days.
LanguageData.CC_GodHush_Saw_MeltRing: Where frost had lain on {DEAD}'s grave at {HOME}, a ring of mushrooms came up.
